result.topic_en: Calculations on theta functions with characteristics and transformation of order p (relations between products of theta series with arguments multiplied by p and p/(p-1)), together with auxiliary computations of finite differences and coefficient recursions for derivatives of $(e^v-1)^{p-1}$.
